name: Congenital Muscular Torticollis
definition: Infant neck postural deformity usually related to sternocleidomastoid shortening, characterized by head tilt to one side and rotation to the opposite side.

investigations.principle: Typical muscular torticollis is a clinical diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Imaging is reserved for atypical, refractory or red-flag cases.

amber: Persistent atypical cases need specialist reassessment before invasive treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva-stambha developmental phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Infant neck postural deformity usually related to sternocleidomastoid shortening, characterized by head tilt to one side and rotation to the opposite side.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
